mail/imap_data#

The structure of an untagged response: atoms, quoted strings, literals and parenthesized lists.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

for ParsedImapData(response).entries() -> value {
    if value.kind() == ImapValueKind.list { value.entries(); }
    else { value.string(); }
}

Description#

The structure of an untagged response: atoms, quoted strings, literals and parenthesized lists.

NIL, "" and () stay distinct; absent() tells NIL. Literals stay bytes. By default 8192 tokens nested at most 64 deep.
